entities.description: A multi-story brick building with white-framed windows and red brick lintels above some of the windows. The building has a traditional architectural style, with a visible tree in front of it partially obscuring the view.

A man with short brown hair, wearing a dark navy suit and white shirt, is standing on a metal ramp, pushing a wheelchair with a person in a red top. He is looking down at the person in the wheelchair.

A young man with short, wavy dark brown hair sits in a black manual wheelchair, turning his head to look back over his left shoulder with a neutral expression. He is wearing a long-sleeved salmon-orange shirt and blue jeans, positioned in front of the open rear door of a vehicle with black leather seats visible behind him.

attributes.pose: sitting in wheelchair, looking over shoulder

entities.description: A silver aluminum ramp with a ribbed surface for traction is positioned on a paved road, leading up to a vehicle. The ramp has yellow edges and is being used to load a wheelchair onto the vehicle.

A person is standing on a metal ramp that is placed on an asphalt road, with the ramp extending up to the side of a vehicle. The person is wearing dark pants and black shoes, and only their lower legs and feet are visible. The ramp has a textured surface for grip and is supported by a small wheel at the bottom end.

A tree with a thick, textured brown trunk and branches extending upward, partially obscuring a brick building with white-framed windows and red brick lintels. Green leaves are visible at the top of the frame, indicating the tree is in a leafy state.

attributes.background: brick building with white windows and red lintels
attributes.position: centered in frame, partially obscuring background

entities.description: A silver minivan is parked on a street with its rear hatch open and a metal ramp extended from the back, allowing a person in a wheelchair to be pushed into the vehicle. The van features black interior seats, a visible rear wheel with a silver alloy rim, and red taillights.

A black manual wheelchair with a padded backrest and armrests is positioned on a metal ramp, with a person wearing a red top and blue jeans seated in it. The wheelchair features large rear wheels with silver spokes and smaller front casters, and a hand is visible gripping the handle at the back.
